# openwrt_qos_class (Resource)

A qos-scripts traffic class (`config class`).

Manages a `class` section in `/etc/config/qos`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `avgrate` (Number) Average rate in percent. (UCI option `avgrate`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `limitrate` (Number) Rate limit in percent. (UCI option `limitrate`.)
- `maxdelay` (Number) Maximum delay in ms. (UCI option `maxdelay`.)
- `maxsize` (Number) Maximum packet size. (UCI option `maxsize`.)
- `packetdelay` (Number) Packet delay in ms. (UCI option `packetdelay`.)
- `packetsize` (Number) Average packet size. (UCI option `packetsize`.)
- `priority` (Number) Priority. (UCI option `priority`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
